headline: Fintech Firm Paga Expands Direct Debit Access Beyond Internal Network
summary: Nigerian payment platform Paga expanded its Paga Engine service, allowing merchant clients to collect recurring direct debit payments from accounts outside its internal network.
why: Paga is a major financial technology provider in West Africa specializing in digital payments and agency banking.

impacts.name: Paga
impacts.why: Broadening direct debit integration enables higher recurring transaction volumes for business accounts.
